tool_input.command: for f in $(find crates -maxdepth 2 -name Cargo.toml); do echo "== $f =="; cat "$f"; done

result:
One binary, three lib crates:

- **`carto` bin** — `crates/carto-cli/src/main.rs` (package `carto-cli`). Only real entry point; thin `run(cli) -> Result<u8>` dispatch, mounts `serve` (MCP) too.
- **`carto-core`** lib root — `crates/carto-core/src/lib.rs`. No I/O besides fs, no clap/rmcp. Extraction, graph, query, redact, pathguard live here.
- **`carto-mcp`** lib root — `crates/carto-mcp/src/lib.rs`. MCP stdio server, mounted by CLI's `serve` subcommand — not its own binary.
- **`carto-grammars`** lib root — `crates/carto-grammars/src/lib.rs`. Tree-sitter grammar loading, workspace's one `unsafe_code` carve-out.

No other `[[bin]]` targets anywhere — `carto` is it.
